craft_notes: Sthāyin: counted-japa (the number as doctrine: six-hundreds by day, 1021 by night — the goddess's muting). Rows: row 1 (count uncut — never trim a ladder). Close: dull (manda — the sting lands last: easy, hard FOR THE DULL). Rejected: rounding to 66,000 — killed: L3's count kept (L4 traces L3, never corrects upward); 'ajapa-japa' label — killed: muting kept (the verse's own paradox-word: her silence that counts).

lines: Six hundreds by day, thousand twenty-one by night:
goddess's muting declared — easy, hard for dull.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭśatāni divā rātrau sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ | japo devyāḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sulabho durlabho jaḍaiḥ
